facts.fact: The ICT ministry is upgrading the existing government chatbot DIVA, and Cabinet approved DIVA as the official chatbot for all ministries and departments, to roll out in phases starting with 15.

The ICT ministry launched a public, private-sector and civil-society consultation to define a global AI strategy, to be steered by a planned Artificial Intelligence Unit under the Digital Transformation 2025-2029 blueprint.

MUS.note: The unit is not yet created, so no body is recorded.
No model, dataset or AI computing stated.
